player_prompt.intro:
Nanhte Player {player_id} shani {num_rounds}-mung IteratedTwoThirdsAverage ahkying.
Mung shani kaw nna, {min_guess} kaw {max_guess} kasha ninghkap re.
Kaw ninghkap ninghku mi, target ninghkap (2/3)x(ninghkap mi ahkying ninghku average),
ninghkap target shingra kaw ninghkap re Player mung shani ninghku.
Ninghkap re '[<number>]' ninghku format shingra kaw.

invalid_move.wrong_format: N jaw ai format; nang chye mayu yang [<number>] hku nna ka u.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Hkum sha ai lam {min_guess} na {max_guess} shut dai.

message.round_guesses: 0 လီဆာ {guess0} ခဲးဆာ; 1 လီဆာ {guess1} ခဲးဆာ။ ထဲ့လီဆာ ဆာခဲးဆာ: {target}။
message.round_win: Player {winner} gaw, man yawng dang ai!

outcome.p0_wins: Dai shaloi, player 0 gaw raundi law htum lu ai.
outcome.p1_wins: Hkaw ai wa 1 gaw, dang lu na matu grau nna shakut nga ai.
outcome.draw: Yawng jahtum hta, ginsup ai lam gaw dang hkra sha re.
